tests.name: json_pointer_fast_array_index
tests.intent: Probe array-index parsing optimization with fast digit loop for values under 18 digits.

tests.name: json_pointer_equals_string
tests.intent: Probe direct string comparison with json_pointer via equals_string without splitting.

tests.name: json_pointer_to_string_buffer
tests.intent: Probe optimized single-buffer to_string formatting with escaped tokens.

tests.name: json_pointer_operator_slash_reserve
tests.intent: Probe operator/ overloads for json_pointer concatenation and size_t append using reserve.

tests.name: json_pointer_parent_pointer
tests.intent: Probe parent_pointer range-based construction from begin() and end() - 1.

tests.name: json_pointer_lookup_accessors
tests.intent: Probe direct container access in get_checked, contains, and get_checked_or_null.

tests.name: json_pointer_non_const_get_unchecked
tests.intent: Probe non-const get_unchecked and operator[] avoiding key copies.

tests.name: json_pointer_unflatten_optimized
tests.intent: Probe linear-time unflatten with open-addressing table and parent links.

tests.name: json_patch_operations_speedup
tests.intent: Probe optimized patch execution avoiding redundant copies for add, remove, move, and copy.

tests.name: string_escape_into
tests.intent: Probe detail::escape_into appending escaped strings into existing buffers.

tests.name: string_escape_scan
tests.intent: Probe detail::escape scanning once for both special characters '~' and '/' without extra copies.

tests.name: string_unescape_move
tests.intent: Probe detail::unescape moving its result string instead of copying.

tests.name: json_pointer_split_validation
tests.intent: Probe pointer token splitting skipping ~ validation/unescaping when no ~ is present.

tests.name: json_pointer_equals_string_errors
tests.intent: Probe error throwing in equals_string for missing slashes and invalid escapes.

tests.name: json_patch_add_missing_ancestor
tests.intent: Probe patch add operation throwing via at() when parent or ancestors do not exist.

tests.name: json_patch_move_root_edge_case
tests.intent: Probe move operation edge case where from_ptr is empty root.

tests.name: json_patch_copy_validation
tests.intent: Probe copy operation validating that from location exists using at().

tests.name: json_pointer_array_index_overflow
tests.intent: Probe array index parsing with numbers exceeding size_type limits or malformed strings.

tests.name: json_pointer_empty_and_root
tests.intent: Probe empty json_pointer handling and root access behaviors.

tests.name: json_pointer_streaming_operator
tests.intent: Probe ostream operator<< for json_pointer formatting.

tests.name: test_throw_no_parent
tests.intent: Trigger throw_no_parent by calling pop_back or top on an empty json_pointer.

tests.name: test_array_index_non_digit_break
tests.intent: Exercise parse_array_index with a string containing a non-digit character early in the fast digit loop.

tests.name: test_equals_string_empty_and_mismatch
tests.intent: Exercise equals_string with empty pointers and mismatching token comparisons.

tests.name: test_unflatten_complex
tests.intent: Exercise unflatten on a flattened object with nested objects to instantiate the prefix_tree and grow/get_and_create mechanisms.

tests.name: test_patch_root_and_append
tests.intent: Exercise patch operation adding to root (ptr empty) and appending to array with '-' via JSON patch.

tests.intent: Probe detail::escape_into appending escaped strings into existing buffers.
